name: io.github.imouiche/mitre-atlas-mcp-server
title: MITRE ATLAS MCP Server
description: Threat-model AI and agentic systems against MITRE ATLAS: surfaces, techniques, controls

environmentVariables.name: MITRE_ATLAS_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Python 3.12+ interpreter to use directly. When set, no virtualenv is created and the interpreter must already satisfy the dependencies in pyproject.toml.

environmentVariables.name: MITRE_ATLAS_RUNTIME_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the cached virtualenv prepared on first run. Defaults to ~/.mitre-atlas-mcp-server/runtime.
